prompts.a_light_race:
Use case: ui-mockup, high fidelity style transfer.
Create ONE portrait screenshot of the Korean marble racing game, Variant A LIGHT, during race. The provided reference screenshot 03-race-mid.png is the EXACT composition and layout target, not merely inspiration. Preserve its ~640x800 aspect ratio and every UI region's proportion; render crisply with readable Korean. This is an app UI screenshot filling the entire image, not a device mockup, not a presentation board. Do NOT invent a new layout or extra labels.

INVARIANTS / LAYOUT:
Keep the narrow single-row header, tall central playfield, lower sound/pause toolbar and bottom count/time status strip. Keep the large empty playfield gap above the blocks. Keep the three mint obstacle rectangles clipped at the top of the field, each with a few soft wavy lines. Keep seven staggered rows of small salmon-pink keycap blocks in the lower third, matching the gaps and broken upper rows of the reference. Every visible tile bears the digit "4". Preserve all marble locations, their numbers, the animal label below each, and the white space. In normalized 640x800 coordinates: blue marble 4 near (254,125) labeled "고양이"; mint 9 near (310,137) labeled "수달"; partial "펭귄" label near (334,78); pink 5 near (463,357) labeled "오리"; gold 2 near (424,376) labeled "토끼"; blue 8 near (296,395) labeled "펭귄"; green 6 near (233,409) labeled "오리"; lavender 3 near (597,400) labeled "고양이"; mint 1 near (115,458) labeled "토끼". Do not add faces or animals.

STYLE CHANGE ONLY:
Modern clean casual mobile game with understated Korean productivity-app polish. Soft airy very pale blue playfield #F4F8FB, no dot grid. Pale walls #CBD8E2. White-cream header and bottom toolbar #FFFDFC with subtle gray borders #D8E1E8. Clean rounded modest-size controls, medium blue primary button #2476F2. Warm blush pastel keycaps #F4C4BA with soft rounded corners and a short gentle shadow below, pale top surface #FFE1D9; remove the thin nested outlines and hard old-fashioned borders. Upper mint obstacles #B9D9C8. Marbles are flat single solid pastel colors with only ONE small white glint at upper left and a light same-hue shadow below. No dark glossy gradients, no chrome, no neon, no bloom. Numbers are dark and centered. Nameplates are small rounded white pills with dark slate text #334155, comfortable but compact, readable at normal scale; they occupy the same positions as existing labels. Avoid oversized or balloon-like balls.

TEXT MUST BE EXACT, CLEAR KOREAN SANS SERIF:
Header at left "도각도각 키보드" and "경기 중".
Header buttons in this order: "1배속", "자리섞기", "스킬 사용 ON", "미니맵 OFF", "전체화면 ↗".
No separator dots inside the buttons. Keep all five in the narrow header row as in the reference.
Bottom toolbar left music-note icon followed by "소리 켜짐" and a small mint volume slider. Right blue button "일시정지 II".
Bottom status left "0 / 10 도착", right "00:32".
Names must read exactly: "고양이", "토끼", "오리", "펭귄", "수달".
Show the complete entire UI with modest rounded outer corners. Keep text correct rather than decorative. No watermark, no extra title, no logo.
prompts.a_light_result:
Use case: ui-mockup / style transfer. Generate ONE polished portrait Korean marble racing game RESULT screenshot, variant A LIGHT, aspect ratio of image 1 around 640x830. Image 1 (dark current 04-result.png) is the EXACT composition/layout target. Image 2 (light race screenshot) is ONLY the color/material/typography style reference. Preserve image 1 positions, sizes and proportions. Do not use the racing-block layout from image 2.

Keep image 1's two-line header with small title/status above five buttons, the same central funnel geometry, the centered result card and the small winners card at lower right, the bottom sound/restart toolbar, and bottom count/time strip. Keep the large V-shaped guide walls descending from the top left and top right to the two narrow vertical chute walls; their exact geometry is important. Keep the diagonal rotating finish bar visible BEHIND the result dialog from the left edge around 40% height to center around 58% height, but change its appearance. Preserve reference UI margins. No blocks or floating marbles in this result screen.

Change appearance to modern clean casual UI matching image 2: very pale blue #F4F8FB arena with NO dotted grid, subtle pale outer walls #CBD8E2; white/cream #FFFDFC header and toolbar; gray borders #D8E1E8 and blue #2476F2 primary buttons. Funnel guide walls must be rounded soft light gray #CDD8DE lines with gentle dimensionality; no glow. Rotating finish bar must be a clearly visible opaque solid CORAL #EF8F82 rounded bar; NO neon, NO teal glow. Replace the checkerboard finish line at the bottom of the chute with a SINGLE solid MINT ribbon #55BFA6, with "도착" immediately below. No checker pattern anywhere. Put a WHITE result card #FFFFFF with rounded corners and soft understated shadow in the same centered rectangle as image 1, about x110-530 y285-535 on a 640x830 canvas. Slate dark text #334155, light winner pill, familiar blue and secondary white buttons. Do not darken the whole arena with a scrim. Winners list lower right also a white card with soft shadow, a light border and dark text. Keep only the small existing celebration emoji/icon; don't add confetti illustrations or characters.

All text must be EXACT legible Korean sans serif:
Header small title "도각도각 키보드", status "경기 종료".
Header second-row buttons left to right: "1배속", "자리섞기", "스킬 사용 ON", "미니맵 OFF", "전체화면 ↗".
Centered card: headline "축하합니다!", subtext "첫번째 도착 당첨", winner pill "펭귄 7번", primary button "한 번 더 굴리기 ↻", secondary button "결과 복사".
Small lower-right winners card: "🎉 당첨 1명", row "1." then a small pastel peach circle then "펭귄", with "7번" right aligned.
Bottom toolbar left music icon "소리 켜짐", small mint slider, right blue button "다시 시작 ↻".
Bottom status left "10 / 10 도착", right "00:52".
Do not invent or translate text. No watermarks, no branding additions, no device frame. Show whole screenshot.
prompts.a_dark_race:
Use case: ui-mockup / style transfer. Edit this light Korean marble racing screenshot into Variant A DARK. Create one portrait screenshot with the SAME aspect ratio ~640x800 and EXACT SAME composition, geometry, layout, all blocks, all marbles, every Korean label, spacing, UI structure, button sizes and proportions as the input. Change ONLY theme colors and their lighting. Do not move, add, delete or resize objects. Preserve seven staggered lower rows of rounded pastel salmon keycaps with digit 4, the large empty field area, three top mint wave obstacles and eight visible numbered marbles at the current positions.

Dark color palette: arena uniform low-saturation blue-gray charcoal #28333E, NOT saturated navy or black. No dotted grid. Outer side wall lines #52616D. Header and lower toolbar #303E4A; bottom status strip same charcoal family. Button borders #5A6A78, low-contrast darker button backgrounds, text light gray #E5EDF4. Primary pause button softly saturated light blue #75A7F3 with dark slate text, no glow. Disabled shuffle button slightly muted but readable. Retain pastel peach/salmon keycaps #F4C4BA with pale face #FFE1D9 and soft shadow below, no nested outlines. Upper wave obstacles muted mint #9DBFAE. Marbles retain the input's SAME flat pastel hues, centered dark numbers, single small top-left white glint and light same-color lower shadow; no dark glossy gradient or shiny chrome. Nameplate pills light gray-white #E9EFF3 with dark #26323D text in the same positions. All names are easy to read. Keep restrained soft shadows; no neon, glow or luminous edges.

Keep EXACT readable text:
Title "도각도각 키보드", status "경기 중".
Five header buttons "1배속", "자리섞기", "스킬 사용 ON", "미니맵 OFF", "전체화면 ↗".
Nameplates "고양이", "수달", "펭귄", "오리", "토끼" in original locations and paired with same marble numbers.
Lower toolbar music icon + "소리 켜짐", a small mint slider; right button "일시정지 II".
Bottom "0 / 10 도착" and "00:32".
No faces on marbles, no extra text, no new design, no watermark.
prompts.b_light_race:
Use case: ui-mockup / style transfer. Edit this Korean marble-racing screenshot into Variant B LIGHT. ONE portrait screenshot, keep SAME aspect ratio ~640x800. Preserve EXACT geometry and all layout, every block row, all gaps, every marble and nameplate position, all Korean text and buttons. Only recolor the surfaces. The variant must look distinctly different from the reference light-blue/salmon variant: make a warm oatmeal-and-deep-plum color system with SOFT LAVENDER keycaps and SAGE obstacles.

Palette: warm very light beige arena #F7F0E5, no dotted grid, soft tan wall lines #D6CAB9. Header and lower toolbar warm ivory #FFFBF4, borders #D8CBB9, text dark plum #4D3D62. Main pause button deep muted purple #66508E with white Korean text. Skill button soft lavender background and purple outline, not teal. The seven staggered keycap rows become soft lavender #D8C9ED with pale lavender top surfaces #EAE0F7 and subtle same-color bottom shadows. Rounded corners, no inset dark outlines. Top three wave rectangles muted sage #BDCFB1 with delicate pale waves. Keep the same pastel marble colors with dark centered numbers, ONE tiny top-left white glint and a gentle same-hue lower shadow. Nameplates warm white #FFFCF7 pills with dark plum #4D3D62 lettering. Volume slider muted purple. Warm clean friendly casual-game finish with flat color, mild depth, no grain or busy decoration, no glow. Retain the same considerable blank space above the blocks. Do not rearrange, scale, remove or add any items.

All Korean must remain EXACT and crisp:
Title "도각도각 키보드", status "경기 중".
Buttons in order: "1배속", "자리섞기", "스킬 사용 ON", "미니맵 OFF", "전체화면 ↗".
Labels "고양이", "수달", "펭귄", "오리", "토끼" stay on the same marbles as the reference.
Toolbar left "소리 켜짐", right "일시정지 II".
Bottom count "0 / 10 도착" and timer "00:32".
No faces, no extra characters, no invented text, no watermark. The output is a finished UI screenshot, not a phone mockup or mood board.
